title: UK car industry to press EU for two-year delay to Brexit EV tariffs
summary_full: ‘Rules of origin’ on vehicle batteries due to come into force on 1 January if deal on new delay is not reachedBusiness live – latest updatesThe UK car industry is preparing to push for a two-year delay to Brexit tariffs on electric cars traded with the EU, after an initial European proposal suggested a shorter delay.Tariffs are due to kick in on 1 January for the majority of electric cars traded between the EU and UK unless the two sides can come to an agreement to delay for a second time the implementation of “rules of origin” on batteries.
